articles.title: Arizona Voters Are Worried About Water
articles.summary: A survey says water is now the top worry for many Arizona voters during a long drought.

articles.title: Latino Museum Gets a Home on the National Mall
articles.summary: The National Museum of the American Latino will move into a 145-year-old building on the National Mall.

articles.title: Two Americans Win the Nobel Prize in Economics
articles.summary: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford won for ideas that help leaders handle sudden changes in the economy.
